segments.name: Proteomics
segments.description: Provides researchers with unbiased, deep, rapid and large-scale access to the proteome through its Proteograph Product Suite.
segments.evidence: Through our product, the Proteograph® Product Suite (Proteograph), we provide researchers with unbiased, deep, rapid and large-scale access to the proteome, enabling biological discovery that has historically been impractical.

revenueModel.text: Customers, including academic institutions, biopharmaceutical companies, biobanks and clinical research organizations, pay for the Proteograph Product Suite of consumable assays, an automation instrument and data analysis software.
revenueModel.evidence: The Proteograph Product Suite is a comprehensive solution consisting of consumable assays, an automation instrument, and data analysis software.
